d: Rixos Premium Qetaifan Island North offers guests a luxurious breakaway to an island packed with entertainment and adventure. With five acres of fun-filled attractions, including a sensational waterpark, private beach, retail area, a beach club, and numerous fine dining and casual restaurants, Rixos Premium Qetaifan Island North is the ultimate multi-inclusive vacation destination.

We are seeking an accomplished and visionary Executive Pastry Chef to lead our pastry kitchen operations in Lusail, Qatar. In this pivotal role, you will oversee all pastry production and service, ensuring every creation meets our exacting standards of excellence while maintaining the highest levels of food safety and quality. You will be responsible for developing innovative seasonal menus, managing a talented pastry team, and delivering an exceptional culinary experience that reflects our commitment to luxury hospitality.
Lead and manage all pastry kitchen operations, taking full responsibility for production, service, and adherence to our organization's standards of excellence
Create, develop, and update comprehensive department standards, including recipe specifications, steps of service, and cost control measures
Maintain meticulous stock control and inventory management, ensuring stock levels align with company requirements and implementing proper rotation procedures
Oversee the ordering of food goods and equipment through appropriate channels, and report maintenance needs promptly
Ensure correct storage, labeling, and organization of all foodstuffs, equipment, and dry goods across kitchen areas
Develop and implement seasonal menus while maximizing kitchen sales potential through regular menu engineering and analysis
Collate recipes for new dishes, manage cost control, and implement innovative culinary concepts across all outlets
Serve as a hands-on leader and mentor, fostering a positive kitchen culture aligned with our organizational values
Manage, coach, and develop all pastry kitchen team members through regular one-on-ones, performance reviews, and annual appraisals
Set clear targets and expectations while actively encouraging creativity, innovation, and professional growth
Maintain discipline and lead by example, providing guidance and support to resolve challenges and troubleshoot issues
Represent the department at management meetings and contribute to hotel-wide advancement initiatives
Demonstrate composure under pressure and provide decisive leadership during high-volume service periods
Recognize and celebrate team contributions to foster motivation and engagement
Work collaboratively with front-of-house, beverage, and all food and beverage outlet teams to ensure seamless, consistent service
Communicate with clarity and professionalism with both staff and guests, anticipating needs and delivering luxury-level service
Support the wider hotel team and assist with troubleshooting guest and client challenges as needed
Maintain detailed and transparent communication regarding operational matters, standards, and expectations
Ensure strict adherence to all health and safety legislation, fire procedures, emergency protocols, and bomb procedures
Identify and report all potential and real hazards immediately, taking corrective action as needed
Stimulate and encourage a culture of health and safety awareness among all team members
Ensure the safety of all persons and property within the premises through vigilant adherence to applicable laws and regulations
Perform additional responsibilities as assigned, including working in different departments or outlets as needed to support business operations
q: Recent and proven experience working in multi-outlet venues or 5-star hotel environments
Advanced pastry techniques and culinary expertise with a strong foundation in food and beverage knowledge
Demonstrated experience managing and leading a pastry kitchen team in a high-volume, luxury hospitality setting
Exceptional attention to detail with a consistent, organized approach to all tasks and responsibilities
Proven ability to deliver high-quality service and maintain composure under pressure
Strong time management skills with the ability to multitask effectively while maintaining professional standards
Excellent communication skills, both written and spoken, with the ability to engage with diverse audiences
Proficiency in menu development, recipe costing, and culinary analysis
Knowledge of food safety, health and hygiene standards, and kitchen compliance requirements
Experience with inventory management, stock control, and budget management
Flexibility and willingness to work within a 24-hour operational schedule when required
Enthusiasm and commitment to delivering exceptional service and experiences in all situations
Extensive experience in luxury hotel environments with exposure to LQA, Forbes 5-star, or equivalent standards
Demonstrated understanding of the luxury sector and experience serving ultra-high-net-worth clientele
Market knowledge of competitors and current event industry trends
Advanced culinary certifications or formal pastry training from recognized institutions
Experience with kitchen equipment management and kitchen technology systems
Passion for hospitality with a genuine commitment to continuous improvement and innovation
Background in staff training program development and culinary education
Experience with menu engineering and sales optimization strategies
